entities.summary: Möng Mao or Möng Mao Lông, also known as Maw or Luchuan in other sources, was a Tai kingdom that flourished from the 14th to 15th centuries, and consolidated dominance over the frontier regions of modern-day Myanmar, China, and India. The core territory was centered on the Nam Mao (Ruili) river basin.
